## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see [DCO](../DCO)).
- [ ] The tests and checks pass locally (`swift test`, and `cargo test` in `keeper/` if you touched it).
- [ ] No explicit material anywhere, including tests and screenshots.
- [ ] Nothing here makes it easier to get around the lock, or hides anything other than explicit sexual content.
- [ ] **Touches the lock** (`keeper/`, `opener/`, the time lock or the update gate)? Then it needs a second reader before merging.
- [ ] If you used an AI coding tool, it followed [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
